CALMNOSIS creates original music that explores the intersection of smooth jazz, cinematic atmosphere, hypnotic rhythm, and emotional expression. Since our first worldwide album release in 2021, the sound has grown into long-form listening sessions and wordless short films — music built to change the state of the room it plays in.

About · The Artist

THE MUSIC OF NIKKOS ZORBAS

CALMNOSIS is the music of Nikkos Zorbas — composer, producer, and creator of the NEUROJAZZ sound. One catalogue, many rooms: deep-focus sessions for work and study, calm sessions for reset, and wordless films where the music carries the whole story.

The road here began on vinyl. Recording as Nikkos, he released the 12-inch single “Don’t Fear The Rave,” produced with Roy Hay of Culture Club and Hein Hoven — and served as a voting member of the Recording Academy, which presents the GRAMMY Awards. CALMNOSIS is where that lifetime in sound arrived: music built to be felt, not just heard.

Also from Nikkos Zorbas:
